input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Root cause found: in `handleClick`, `exportReport(reportId, format).then(...)` only has a success handler and no `.catch()`/`finally`. When the export fails (e.g. the fetch resolves with a non-2xx status, which makes `exportReport` throw), `setBusy(false)` is never called, so `busy` stays `true` and the button and format selector remain disabled until the page is reloaded.

Fix: handle the rejection path, e.g. wrap in try/catch/finally or add `.catch()` that shows an error toast, and always call `setBusy(false)` regardless of success or failure.

input.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
input.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. In handleClick, the call to exportReport only has a .then() handler and no .catch(), so when the promise rejects (e.g. a non-2xx response throws in exportReport), setBusy(false) is never called and the button stays disabled until the page is reloaded. Add a .catch() (or try/catch with async/await) that resets busy to false and shows an error toast when the export fails, so the button becomes clickable again after a failure.
